items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Mr. Groeschel, he was determined because I'm working at one corner, and he's at Pete Lawless at the next corner... he'd tell him, say, you better get a band in there, I'd say, cut that fella out there.

ctx.x: Well you won the contest then.

Oh yeah. Yeah, because Mr. Groeschel, he was determined because I'm working at one corner, and he's at Pete Lawless at the next corner. See? And Joe, they'd all pass and kick one another at night. If he'd see my boss out there, he'd tell him, say, you better get a band in there, I'd say, cut that fella out there. He can't see, he can't play, he can't blow, nothing. You know, talk about him, kick one another. Yeah, yeah. Now he's got one eye himself, he cock-eyed himself, see? But yet and still, he was just a…
That's not heard there. He used to kid everybody a lot.
